name: Fixture A — irregular earner

region.notes: Transport costs change a lot when it rains.

economic_frame.how_money_arrives: Daily sales, cash and mobile money
economic_frame.stability: Some weeks are good, some are very slow

sensitivities: Don't tell me to cut what I send home

emotional_baseline.encouragement: Be straight with me, no cheerleading

memories: Rainy week again. Sales were slow and matatu fares went up, so I only made it to the chama with half my share.
My sister's school fees are due in January. That always comes first.
